resources.string: HSH Connect Blocker & Screen Time Service
This app\'s settings are protected by hostel policy.
%1$s can\'t be stopped. It is required by hostel policy.

Monitors and restricts prohibited applications during study and curfew hours as configured by the hostel administration. It reads what is on screen to find the app in use, and to keep this app from being stopped from its App info page or the Active apps panel.
